players.product: infrared and visible optical components, Black Diamond infrared glass (used instead of germanium), assemblies and modules, and infrared cameras

quarterly_data.signal: LightPath agreed on July 23, 2026 to sell 100% of LightPath (Zhenjiang) Optical Instrumentation Co., Ltd. (LPOIZ), its manufacturing facility and operations in China, to Hengtu Optical Technology Co., Ltd., owned by Mr. Leo Zheng and members of LPOIZ's current management (deal price excluded). Supply terms: for the first five years after closing (the Exclusive Supply Term) LPOIZ continues to supply products to LightPath, priced at cost plus ten percent (10%), rising by five percent (5%) for every $1,000,000 of principal the purchaser pays and fixed at cost plus thirty percent (30%) once the price is fully paid; the purchaser will continue to supply LightPath with products for its commercial customers in the U.S. and Europe as a third-party vendor. The release says LightPath generated an average of approximately $4.5 million of annual revenue from third-party customers of the China operation in fiscal 2025 and 2026 (preliminary), which leaves consolidated revenue at closing; after closing LightPath will have no facilities or operations in China (manufacturing in Orlando, Florida, plus Texas, New Hampshire and Latvia). CEO Sam Rubin: the divestiture completes a multi-year transformation into a Western-aligned, vertically integrated provider, and no material impact on supply, quality or service to customers is expected.
quarterly_data.figure: five-year exclusive supply at cost plus 10% rising to cost plus 30%; approximately $4.5 million average annual third-party revenue of the China operation
